opportunities.name: arXiv topic search → Semantic Scholar citation lookup → log note
opportunities.description: For a research topic and year, find a paper on arXiv advanced search, look up its author and citation count on Semantic Scholar, then save a note in the format '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <first author>, <N> citations'.
steps: Open arXiv and click Search, then Advanced search (or New search)
Type the topic into 'Search term...'
Check the date filter checkbox, choose the 'specific_year' radio and type the year in YYYY
Click Search and open the top relevant result (arXiv ID link)
Copy the paper title
On Semantic Scholar, type the title into the search box and submit
Open the matching paper and read the first author and citation count
In the notes app, click 'New note', type '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <first author>, <citations> citations' and press Enter

topic='protein structure diffusion', year=2024 → Accelerating Inference in Molecular Diffusion Models... (Ian Dunn, 7 citations)

opportunities.name: Court case lookup on CourtListener + statute on Cornell LII → log note
opportunities.description: For a given case name, find its citation and decision date on CourtListener, look up the related U.S. Code section on Cornell LII, then save a note in the format '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<section title>)'.
steps: On CourtListener, type the case name into 'Keyword(s) search with operators' and press Enter
Open the matching case result
Read the reporter citation (e.g. 585 U.S. 296) and the decision date
On Cornell LII, type the statute citation into the search box and submit
Open the matching /uscode/text result and read the section title
In the notes app, click 'New note', type '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<section title>)' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Peerspace venue search by activity and city
opportunities.description: Search Peerspace for venues by entering an activity and a city and running the search.
steps: Click the 'Enter your activity' combobox, select all and type the activity
Pick the matching option from the dropdown if one appears
Click 'Enter a city, zip, or address', select all and type the city
Pick the matching location option
Click Search
Look through the venue results
